messages:
alex_finance: Apollo Tech reported their May invoice shows no GPU surcharge and they received two invoices with the same number (INV-2024-05-555). Anyone available to triage?

mo_billing: Looking now. I see invoice record with total USD 12,340.00 but two PDF files exist — one missing the 'reserved_gpu_surcharge' line.

sre-bot: invoice_gen: error tenant=tc_99012 invoice=INV-2024-05-555 error=aggregation_empty partial_write=true

ryan_ops: Quick grep of batch logs shows the aggregator window closed at 2024-05-31T00:00:00Z; some metrics landed at 2024-05-30T23:59:59.5 and got missed due to strict floor.

mo_billing: Duplicate invoice created because first run partially wrote invoice row and export worker retried and generated another PDF; both were archived.

eva_cs: Customer worried they might have been double-charged. Can we confirm payment status?

mo_billing: Stripe: only one charge processed for USD 12,340.00 at 2024-06-01T15:02:11Z. So no duplicate charge, but the missing surcharge underreports usage affecting committed discount calculations.

ryan_ops: I'll rerun aggregation for tenant tc_99012 for the affected window in dry-run to confirm missed surcharge amount: ``./agg_tool --tenant tc_99012 --start 2024-05-30T00:00:00Z --end 2024-06-01T00:00:00Z --dry``

ryan_ops: Dry-run shows reserved_gpu_surcharge=USD 620.00. That should be an extra line.

mo_billing: Plan: 1) mark duplicate PDF as void in storage 2) patch invoice-generator to make invoice creation idempotent and atomic 3) regenerate corrected invoice and issue to customer with explanation and optional credit if needed.

eva_cs: Please copy me on the customer note. I'll ask them to hold AP until we send the corrected invoice.

alex_finance: Create FIN-4905 and include affected invoice list for window 2024-05-31T00:00:00Z +/- 5m. Also include remediation steps for aggregation window rounding.

mo_billing: Ticket FIN-4905 created. Temp mitigation: expand aggregator window by 1s and disable automatic export retries for invoices created in the 5m window around midnight UTC.

ryan_ops: Deploying patch to billing-engine now (target 10:30 UTC). Will follow up with postmortem once fixed.

eva_cs: Thanks team. Customer wants a confirmation note once corrected invoice is sent.
